answer: Hardware-attested enclaves with monotonic counters resist Sybil attacks in multi-chain AI-agent economies. Audited enclave code binds one keypair to a chip's fused endorsement key and increments an on-die counter each epoch. Verifiers mirror signed counter proofs across a settlement bridge and verify the epoch delta to reject VM clones or cross-chain reuse. Attackers must buy separate physical CPUs per identity, though side-channel key extraction can still enable forged quotes.
